h: First Lady Oluremi Tinubu commissions national headquarters of Tompolo-backed PBAT movement in Abuja
p: First Lady Oluremi Tinubu has reportedly opened the national headquarters of the PBAT Door-to-Door Movement in Abuja, a group linked to Tompolo and supporting President Tinubu's re-election bid. The event is part of the APC's growing 2027 campaign push.
more: Tompolo has reportedly donated campaign vehicles for the re-election drive in Adamawa.
The APC recently inaugurated its presidential campaign council.
Opposition parties are running their own campaign structures.
